title: Softmax
summary: TensorFlow.js softmax converts four logits to normalized probabilities by subtracting the maximum, exponentiating, and dividing by their sum.
formula: softmax(x)ᵢ = exp(xᵢ − max(x)) / Σⱼ exp(xⱼ − max(x))
limitations: Fixed fixture is one four-logit vector; axis selection, masks, batches, gradients, and backend-specific fused kernels are omitted.
The CUDA teaching kernel presents the stable scalar reduction, not TensorFlow.js backend dispatch or timing.

stages.title: Find a stable offset
stages.summary: Find the largest logit and subtract it before evaluating exponentials.
stages.insight: The reduction is shared across the full softmax axis.

stages.title: Normalize exponentials
stages.summary: Sum shifted exponentials and divide each element by the common denominator.
stages.insight: The output values are nonnegative and sum to one within floating-point tolerance.
